/titles/register.why: read off the renders: the two opening pages ask questions, the retrospective page is a topic, every data page states its finding as a long sentence-case claim of two lines (median 72 characters), and page 15 is a label-colon-topic; under each title sits a chart header in bold with its units line, not a subtitle; page 5's title carries a one-line lead-in sentence beneath it

/description.summary: A US statistical agency's release deck: long sentence-case claim titles in sky-blue Times, dense chart pages with one to three small-multiple panels, a solid sky-blue footer band with the agency mark, footer line and page number.
/description.typography: Times New Roman 26pt in sky blue for titles, usually two lines; Arial for everything else: 11pt bold chart headers over 10pt units lines, 9pt axis labels, 9pt bold direct series labels, 9pt source and note lines; italic only for publication names and the footer.
/description.color: White ground, black and dark-grey text, sky blue 0096D7 for titles and the footer band; series in navy, sky blue, maroon, pink, two greens, gold and greys; grey fans for side cases with the named cases in colour; pale tints for range bands; navy-teal and pale blues for tables.
/description.layout: 16:9, title top-left from 0.75 in, content panels side by side under it, each panel a bold header, units line and plot; source and note lines bottom-left above a 0.49 in footer band.
/description.tables: definition tables: navy-teal label cells with white text, pale blue banded description cells, thin white separators, no frame.
/description.imagery: none on content pages except a US map inset.
/description.motifs: the dashed grey 2025 rule with '2025' above and 'projections' beside it on every time series; series named in coloured bold words at line ends instead of legends; Data source / Note lines.
not_seen: data value labels on bars or lines
/description.tone: neutral, statistical, factual; claims state direction across cases rather than recommend

/derivation_rules: A highlighted case or series is drawn in a saturated series colour and named in that colour; the rest of the fan is grey.
Range bands take the pale tint of their line's hue as it renders over white.
A new text level takes the nearest of the observed sizes 9, 10, 11, 14 pt in Arial; nothing new below 8 pt.
Text set in a series colour must read 3:1 on white: gold and light grey are strokes and fills only, their words go in the darker neighbour.
/notes/fonts: Jost (italic) is used only for the cover title of the reference, which this section does not have; Arial and Times New Roman are measured with their metric aliases Liberation Sans and Liberation Serif.

/typography/roles/type.footer.why: the two footer lines in the sky-blue band ('AEO2026, U.S. Energy Information Administration' over the date) are 10pt Arial italic in white on every content page; drawn as page content here because the band itself is mined as a rule (see notes)

/typography/roles/type.page_number.why: the page number at the band's right end is 14pt Arial bold in white

/typography/roles/type.units.why: each chart header's units line ('quadrillion British thermal units') is 10pt Arial regular in black, set tight under the bold header

/notes/chrome_band: chrome-1, the 0.486 in sky-blue footer band, is mined as kind 'rule' (its aspect is over MOTIF_RULE_ASPECT 20) and --chrome draw paints it as a hairline, leaving the white footer words on white (refused 1.0:1 on the round trip). The section builds with --chrome none and draws the band, mark, footer lines and page number as page content in the guide's roles.
